headline: Clean: the missing 0.25% checking boost and 0.025% relationship bonus give a unique $33.00 correction.
solution_check: Silver $144,000 is at or above $10,000, so 4.0% (doc_silver_003); the October credit of $480.00 = 144,000 x 4.0% / 12 confirms actual 4.0%. Expected = 4.0 + 0.25 (Green checking -> Silver, green_account_(checking)_001 and pairing #11 in doc_012) + 0.025 relationship bonus (silver_002/005, customer holds savings + checking) = 4.275%; 144,000 x 0.275% / 12 = $33.00. The customer has no credit cards. This matches gold[6] and gold[8].
prior_note: The prior review also rated this task clean.
notes: This task's gold includes the Silver 0.025% relationship bonus for a checking+savings customer; task_097 omits the same bonus for a customer with many more products (see task_097). doc_044 requires the credit to precede the report (soft ordering, not hash-relevant). The interest convention (APY/12 x balance) is inferable from the posted credit.
